title: codonoboea elata

It is native to Southeast Asia, particularly in Thailand and Malaysia, where it grows in tropical forests. The health benefits of Codonoboea elata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation, fight infections, and protect against cell damage.
